title: HOLD-LC-001 direct execution of pinned public GTS likelihood
question: Does the exact public GTS likelihood.py calculate path execute on the pre-registered synthetic fixture and agree with the independent transcription before any event-level work?
method: Clone the public USRA-STI gamma-ray-targeted-search repository into an ignored workspace and check out commit 1bc1e913f97fd7195a7e297f8d6032a5c7758894.
Verify the likelihood.py SHA-256 and use an AST guard to establish that Likelihood.calculate has no reference to the large utils import tree.

Import the pinned module and execute Likelihood.calculate with the existing synthetic six-channel counts/background/background-variance/response fixture; only the unused utils import is stubbed, while NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib execute directly.

Compare the complete finite LLR array and marginalized statistic against the independently coded scalar/transcription audit, mutate one count by +7.0, and exercise the public prethreshold branch with counts equal to background.

Keep event bytes, response templates, detector configuration, response calibration, detector-to-geocenter timing, covariance, intrinsic-lag nuisance, prospective scoring, physical identity and the established T-054/T-059 methods locked.
